# Deterministic audio fixtures

Generated by `make fixtures` (implementation: `scripts/studio.py`, function
`build_fixtures`). Every file is synthesised from fixed note lists and
envelopes: no randomness, no timestamps in the WAV headers, so a rerun writes
byte-identical audio. `make gate` regenerates the whole set in memory and
compares it with the committed files, so a generator change cannot pass
silently.

| File | Content | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `audio/click_120bpm.wav` | 2 bars of 4/4 clicks at 120 BPM, accents on bar starts | 44.1 kHz mono |
| `audio/chords_c_am_f_g.wav` | C, Am, F, G triads, one chord per bar at 120 BPM, key C major | 44.1 kHz mono |
| `audio/tone_440hz.wav` | 440 Hz sine, 2 s | 44.1 kHz mono |
| `audio/silence.wav` | digital silence, 1 s | 44.1 kHz mono |
| `audio/tone_48k_stereo.wav` | 440 Hz sine, 1 s, both channels | 48 kHz stereo |

`manifest.json` records the musical facts of each fixture (tempo, meter, key,
chord order, frequency, frames, rates). Tests compare analysis results against
this manifest, not against the implementation's own output. `SHA256SUMS`
lists the digests of the audio and the manifest.

Regenerate and verify:

```sh
make fixtures
.venv/bin/python scripts/studio.py fixtures-check
```
